goal: Add a `shout(text)` helper in `src/shout.js` that returns the input converted to uppercase with one exclamation mark appended. Add dedicated tests in `test/shout.test.js`.

alternatives.title: CommonJS function export
tradeoffs: Requires matching CommonJS import syntax in the test.

alternatives.title: ES module named export
tradeoffs: Requires matching ES module import syntax in the test.
Provides explicit named-module semantics but depends on the project already supporting ES modules.

self_critique.cut_or_change: Keep the string-input assumption, but verify the existing package and test conventions before choosing the export syntax.
